entries.wording: သွားရောက်ကောက်ယူထားပါသည်။
entries.note: Seen live under the heading Pickup - completed: the office went and collected the parcel from the sender. The sentence starts with the office, which the adapter keeps as the location.

entries.wording: စာဝင်လက်ခံရရှိပါသည်။
entries.note: Seen live under the heading Transit - outbound collected, the first scan of a parcel handed in at a counter and the one after a pickup: the sending office took it in. The sentence, received at the office, is the same for every transit step, so the code stages it.

entries.wording: စာဝင်လက်ခံရရှိပါသည်။
entries.note: Seen live under the heading Transit - outbound received, at a hub after the sending office.

entries.wording: စာဝင်လက်ခံရရှိပါသည်။
entries.note: Seen live under the heading Transit - inbound received, at a sorting centre or the delivering office.

entries.wording: ပို့ဆောင်ရန် ပြင်ဆင်နေပါသည်။
entries.note: Seen live under the heading Delivery - accepted: the delivering office is preparing the delivery. A delivery under way or a failed one follows, so it is a step before the round.
Seen live under the heading Delivery - ongoing: the office is out delivering the parcel.
Seen live under the heading Delivery - completed: delivered successfully.
Seen live under the heading Delivery - rejected: held because the delivery did not succeed. Another delivery followed it.

entries.wording: ထပ်မံပို့ဆောင်ရန် ဆောင်ရွက်ထားပါသည်။
entries.note: Seen live under the heading Delivery - reattempted, after a failed delivery: the office set the parcel for another delivery.
